note: Animal spotter: each Species carries its own assigned colour code, shown on every Detection through a one-hop derived field. A `schedule` ingests deterministic detections from one camera (fixed species, a confidence that bounces between a floor and ceiling — see NOTES); `Detection.created` fires an event that finds every active AlertRule for that species and sends an SMS through the shared `plugins/messaging.mjs`, landing in /outbox. Users manage their own alert rules (species + phone) after registering.

AlertRule.message: Phone must look like a real E.164 number, e.g. +15551234567

Species.name: Wolf
Species.description: A social pack hunter; grey coat, keeps to forested ridgelines and hunts mainly at dawn and dusk.

Species.name: Deer
Species.description: A grazing herbivore; light brown coat, most active in open meadows near dawn.

Species.name: Fox
Species.description: A small, solitary omnivore; vivid orange coat, often seen near the trail cameras at night.

Species.name: Bear
Species.description: A large omnivore; black coat, forages near creeks and can be dangerous if surprised.

Species.name: Eagle
Species.description: A large bird of prey; white head plumage, nests on cliff overlooks and hunts by day.

Species.name: Coyote
Species.description: An adaptable canid; tan coat, ranges across grassland and forest edges, mostly nocturnal.

schedule.name: detect
schedule.note: Ingests one deterministic detection from the trail camera (always a Fox, id 3, for a predictable alert target) with a confidence that bounces between a floor and a ceiling, then checks every active AlertRule for that species and texts it. The match-and-alert step lives here rather than in an `events: Detection.created` hook because `db.createRow` does not fire entity-created events (see NOTES) — only a form-posted create does.
